title: A Sunday at the Market
text:
Mark is at the market on Sunday. He wants red apples and a big bag of rice. The market is busy, so he goes early.

Mark pays for the rice with a card. The seller gives him a bag and says thank you. Mark is tired, so he goes home by bus.

questions.text: What does Mark want to buy?
options: Red apples and a big bag of rice

questions.text: How does Mark pay for the rice?
What can we guess about the market?
options: It is far from Mark's home

questions.text: How does Mark probably feel at the end of the day?

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell food and goods
a small flat plastic piece used to pay for things

paragraph_translations: Mark pazar gününe pazarda. Kırmızı elma ve büyük bir torba pirinç istiyor. Pazar çok yoğun olduğu için erken gidiyor.
Mark pirinç için kartıyla ödeme yapıyor. Satıcı ona bir torba veriyor ve teşekkür ediyor. Mark yorgun olduğu için eve otobüsle gidiyor.
